equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The closest cube defect result uses a three-state excitation rule and cannot map to open-NOR through a state complement or time relabelling: the NOR output is an empty-neighborhood indicator, while Greenberg–Hastings uses a successor-color condition and a distinct three-phase recurrent orbit. The random-induced-cube isolated-vertex event has an extra own-state indicator and is not the NOR first-image or basin event. Similar local dependence does not equate the claims.

value.rationale: The all-zero/all-one two-cycle basin is a natural dynamical invariant, and the theorem resolves its sharp activation-density crossover and the full limiting defect-count mixture of alternative geometric attractors on arbitrarily large Boolean cubes. Exact finite moments, quantitative error and orbit-code interpretation sharpen the result beyond a yes/no threshold.
